name: Heroism, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [hope, mind-affecting]; Level alchemist 2, bard 1, bloodrager 2, inquisitor 2, medium 1, mesmerist 1, paladin 1, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2, witch 2

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell heroism, The target gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks.
